# Independent original feedback checker evidence

These synthetic fixtures were captured from the unchanged original checker,
original daemon AST and real Cython Params/msgq/full Cereal bindings before any
native checker implementation. The source-only live scenario passed all eight
iterations, four valid bounded-timestamp bookmarks, no audio/duplicate output,
exactly four bookmark log messages and clean SIGINT shutdown. Six input packets
retain full original raw audio bytes, sample rate, car button/validity variants
and bookmark validity variants. Four original bookmark byte arrays and one
independently mutated invalid bookmark support non-circular validator controls.

The original-only run used a short exclusively owned runtime directory because
its output-derived ZeroMQ Unix IPC address exceeds the platform length limit
under the long worktree path. The initial unmodified long-path failure is retained
in ignored scratch; neither source nor assertions were changed for the passing
run. After child reaping and IPC cleanup, synthetic evidence was retained under
.analysis/scratch/2026-10-18-feedbackd-tools/. No vehicle data is present.

Eight original CLI controls and three actual child failures are also captured.
The original missing-executable branch leaks its new namespace because Popen
precedes its try/finally; the capture driver recorded and removed only that owned
namespace. The native checker must preserve failure phase while safely owning
cleanup, not reproduce a resource leak. Original readiness, subscriber, shutdown
limits remain 8000, 200 and 3000 milliseconds.

manifest.json binds all corpora and 36 original semantic/mechanical source pins.
Only check_feedbackd.py may become absent after verified retirement; changed or
reintroduced checker source and all retained pins must still reject. The shared
original_params_binding.py remains required for its other consumers. The captured
binding identity is original evidence, not claimed native runtime execution.

The fresh source-matched native daemon was sealed as SHA-256
43bb4229f836b75a3648c5ea0a863947645b10c4283459de812c710036f39226.
The unchanged original checker then passed its complete paired source/native
scenario in 1.99 seconds; full-original-current/receipt.json in the ignored
scratch evidence binds the original report, source files, binding and all three
parent build receipts. A genuine missing-module compile failure was observed
before the independent Rust implementation was written. The native gate passed all five policy/provenance tests and three real IPC/
child-owner tests, strict Clippy and a frozen executable build. A genuine RED
first demonstrated that a dangling retired-checker symlink was mistaken for
absence; the guard now requires actual filesystem absence, with the negative
retained alongside every changed/missing original pin control.

The frozen native checker then passed all eight live iterations and its entire
report object exactly matched the unchanged original checker execution. Its
empty-PATH exec trace contained only the checker/reference ELF and the sealed
candidate ELF, with no interpreter execution. Eight CLI controls explicitly cover
the removal of obsolete binding/source flags. Real early-exit, non-executable
spawn-failure and eight-second readiness-timeout cases retained logs and failure
phases, reaped every spawned child and removed only their owned IPC namespaces.
The actual spawn-failure integration test also preserved a distinct inherited
namespace sentinel, addressing checker defect #362 without claiming a feedback
runtime defect. Exact receipts and logs are indexed in ignored scratch at
native-gate-Cl5efKcP and actual-native-ke73siwi.

The original checker is deleted and CI now builds, tests and runs the native
checker with a mandatory freshly built daemon. The frozen post-deletion proof
actual-native-z0llkzl9 repeats the full original-object comparison, empty-PATH
trace and all failure/cleanup controls successfully. This host validation does
not establish audio recording support, manager launch or device acceptance.
